name: curator_query
query: SELECT TOP 1 'https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/' || ar.uri || '?center=210.80227,54.34895d&size=0.1' AS cutout_url,p.time_bounds_lower AS mjd,p.energy_bandpassname AS bandpass,o.collection AS collection FROM spherex.artifact ar JOIN spherex.plane p ON ar.planeid=p.planeid JOIN spherex.observation o ON o.obsid=p.obsid WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',210.80227,54.34895),p.poly) AND p.energy_bandpassname='SPHEREx-D2' ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
